SELECT id, course_id AS courseId, course_name AS courseName, class_name AS className, sign_code AS signCode, teacher_id AS teacherId, status, create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(reminder_type, 'sign') AS reminderType, schedule_id AS scheduleId, reminder_date AS reminderDate, expire_time AS expireTime FROM sign_reminders WHERE class_name = #{className} AND status = 'pending'
AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > NOW())
ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.course_id AS courseId, r.course_name AS courseName, r.class_name AS className, r.sign_code AS signCode, r.teacher_id AS teacherId, r.status, r.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(r.reminder_type, 'sign') AS reminderType, r.schedule_id AS scheduleId, r.reminder_date AS reminderDate, r.expire_time AS expireTime, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.location AS location, t.teacher_name AS teacherName FROM sign_reminders r INNER JOIN students stu ON stu.class_name = r.class_name LEFT JOIN schedules s ON r.schedule_id = s.id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON r.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE stu.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.status = 'pending' AND (r.expire_time IS NULL OR r.expire_time > NOW()) ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.reminder_type, 'sign') = 'class' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.create_time DESC
